01 • Executive Summary

Strategic Mandate & Opportunity

Click Customize anytime to tailor this text to your specific MBA topic.

Organizations face rising customer acquisition costs and fragmented operational workflows that compress margins. This capstone project evaluates a disciplined, phased transformation: consolidating core workflows, targeting high-margin customer segments, and establishing measurable unit-economics governance to drive sustainable EBITDA expansion.

Core Problem Statement

Legacy manual processes, siloed customer data, and undifferentiated pricing create a 18–24% efficiency gap versus top-quartile peers, limiting scalability into mid-market and enterprise accounts.

Proposed Strategic Solution

Deploy a modular operating model pairing automated workflow orchestration with tiered value-based pricing, unlocking faster onboarding, higher retention, and disciplined capital allocation.

02 • Strategic Analysis

Analytical Framework

1. Market Positioning

Focus commercial resources on high-LTV segments where switching costs are low and time-to-value is under 30 days.

  • Segment-specific value proposition
  • Tiered pricing & packaging

2. Operational Leverage

Standardize repeatable delivery steps and automate reporting to decouple headcount growth from revenue growth.

  • Workflow automation & SLAs
  • Unit cost reduction targets

3. Capital Discipline

Gate capital deployment behind stage-gate milestones, tracking CAC payback and contribution margin monthly.

  • Stage-gate funding releases
  • Monthly KPI board reviews
Strengths
  • • Lean cost structure enabling competitive pricing without sacrificing margin.
  • • Domain expertise and strong early customer validation.
  • • Agile decision-making compared to incumbent enterprise competitors.
Weaknesses
  • • Limited brand awareness in new target verticals.
  • • Reliance on manual onboarding during early pilot phases.
  • • Constrained upfront capital requiring disciplined ROI gating.
Opportunities
  • • Growing demand for integrated, cost-efficient digital solutions.
  • • Strategic channel partnerships to lower customer acquisition cost.
  • • Expansion into adjacent service tiers for existing accounts.
Threats
  • • Aggressive price discounting by entrenched competitors.
  • • Macroeconomic tightening extending enterprise sales cycles.
  • • Regulatory or data-compliance shifts in target regions.
